title: Discovery Upload
description: Sequential compressed capture chunk transport over MQTT upload/discovery framed by config.discovery and state.discovery.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the chunk was emitted

generation.description: Trigger timestamp / session generation ID matching config.discovery and state.discovery

family.description: Protocol family identifier for the trace capture (e.g. bacnet, ether, ipv4)

event_no.description: 0 for start marker, 1..N for gzip-compressed data chunks, and required -(N+1) for stream termination

data.description: Base64-encoded gzip-compressed binary PCAP chunk payload (present for event_no > 0)

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 hex digest of the complete unencoded PCAP file (required on terminal event_no < 0)

scan_manifest.title: Scan Manifest
scan_manifest.description: Metadata describing active discovery scan rounds executed during trace capture

gateway_ip.description: Local gateway IPv4 address used during capture

filter.description: BPF packet filter applied during capture

scan_round_timestamps.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamps marking active Who-Is discovery scan rounds

discovered_routed_networks.description: Routed BACnet DNET numbers discovered via I-Am-Router-To-Network during trace
